dct_title_s: Wildfires in Qastal Maaf Sub-district, Latakia Governorate, Syria as of 4 July 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FR20250707SYR, GDACS ID: 1024188** This map illustrates satellite-detected burned areas in Qastal Maaf Subdistrict, Latakia Governorate, Syria based on Planet Scope image acquired on 4 July 2025 at 11:43 local time. Within the analyzed area of about 30 km², about 4 km² of lands appear to be potentially burned. Based on WorldPop population data and the extent of burned areas (within 1 km), approximately 900 people are potentially exposed or living in close to burned areas. In addition, about 500 buildings are located within 1 km of the burned zones, which may also be at risk or affected. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
